newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says sees Australian unit doubling exports.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says sees Australian unit doubling exports.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Tuesday that it expects its Australian unit to nearly double its vehicle exports in the year 2000 from 14,000 vehicles in 1996.

Toyota chairman Shoichiro Toyoda said in a statement that due to favourable exports of the Camry made by Toyota Motor Corp Australia Ltd, the Australian unit's value- and unit-based export figures for 2000 will be nearly double those of 1996.
Toyoda said in a meeting with Australian Minister for Industry, Science and Tourism John Moore that Toyota would continue its efforts to develop the Australian car industry, the statement said.
The Australian unit produces the Camry and other models.
